traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS are fully implemented and verified. The two core rules (require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation) share a common function detection set, support consistent scope and exportPriority configuration, integrate with both JavaScript and TypeScript via shared helpers, and provide clear, precise error messages at the function name. Advanced @req detection heuristics (linesBeforeHasReq, parentChainHasReq, fallbackTextBeforeHasReq, and hasReqAnnotation) are implemented in src/utils/reqAnnotationDetection.ts and are thoroughly covered by dedicated unit tests. Documentation for both rules exists with examples and option descriptions, and the rules are wired into the plugin’s recommended/strict presets.
